svg.title: Parc's frosted glass hubs over your own picture
svg.desc: A real Parc home screen with the Glass skin, cross-fading between four pictures: sand and slate, rust and graphite, teal and rust, plum and sand. A loupe beside it magnifies the frosted edge of the hubs twice. Text: Frosted glass over your own picture. Both hubs at 35 percent opacity.
